0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-5, 9th in the East) host the Celtics (5-2, 3rd in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, Charlotte's 10th of the season, as the home side enters on a four-game losing streak. Boston is 4-0 at home and sits 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, while Charlotte is 3rd in the Southeast, also 1.5 games back, and Grant Williams is out for the Hornets with a hamstring injury, and Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest). The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Hornets lost 1-2, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026.
